description: Starts TIA Portal (or attaches to an idle instance) WITHOUT opening a project. Class M-off (offline mutation). `headless` only applies when CREATING a new instance (when attaching, it inherits the existing mode). Step 1 of the proactive trust-GATE flow: tia_start → tia_show_ui → tia_connect. Maps to POST /tia/start. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.

headless.description: true = no window (fast offline authoring); false (default) = with window. Only when creating a new instance.

name: tia_start
title: TIA — start/attach (no project)
